facts.fact: The Electoral Commission of South Africa issued by Government Gazette notice 4138 of 4 September 2026 an Electoral Code of Conduct binding on parties and candidates until results are declared, which requires AI-generated 'synthetic content' to be labelled before distribution and bars deceptive synthetic content intended to mislead.

systems.system: Electoral Code of Conduct Countering Disinformation in the Local Government Elections

ZAF.note: Nothing on government use of AI.
Nothing on AI in a sector system.
Nothing on AI built or hosted in the country.
Cites the Protection of Personal Information Act only in passing; states no standing, authority, regulations or application.
Real411 takes disinformation complaints, not complaints about public services.
Code regulates party conduct; no cut, punishment, repeal or bar is stated.
No consultation on a digital law or policy is stated.
